title: LOOK!
skill_description: Visual tracking, handling books, recognizing that print carries meaning.
author: FunBookies
summary: A wordless pattern book introducing the concept of looking and observing simple objects.
targetPhonics: Letters O, I, L only - basic visual discrimination

pages.scene: A friendly eye looking at the viewer with wonder. Simple, bold illustration.
Three round oranges in a row. Simple bold shapes.
Two round eyes looking up. Cute owl face.
A tall tree with a little bird. Vertical shapes.
One big full moon in a night sky.
A child pointing at the sky with wonder.
A smiling sun in the sky.
